label: fixture
rationale: Fixture policy frozen by T6 phase 1 (2026-10-18) before any T6 test run. Token/article/concurrency caps are the D7/D32 hard gates (12,000 cumulative input tokens, 1,500 cumulative output tokens, 20 articles, 30 concurrent requests). One chat call and zero retries per request (spec section 7). Deadline 20 s: the p95 8 s target is a measurement goal, not a timeout; 2.5x headroom keeps fixture runs stable while staying below the 30 s agent deadline reserved for T14. Per-call timeout 15 s leaves at least 5 s of the request deadline for retrieval and final checks, and is always capped by the remaining deadline. framing_reserve_tokens 256 covers per-article JSON framing differences between the T5 context format and the T6 provider payload; min_evidence_tokens 16 equals retrieval-policy.v3 min_truncated_span_tokens. Fixture pricing (1 input, 4 output fixture micro-USD per token, 2,000 per call, cap 20,000) is NOT a provider price: one call at full caps costs exactly 20,000, so the cap never blocks a legal single call, while two calls whose cumulative tokens stay within caps exceed it (independently testable cost guard). Live activation must approve real rates and a tokenizer mapping separately.

pricing.note: Fixture rates for admission/accounting tests only; not a provider price or a measured cost.
